say:1:1033702001:1.text: Based on our investigation, they seem to have fled.
say:1:1033702001:1.source_cn: 按照我们的调查推断，他们应该是逃走了。
say:1:1033702001:1.male: Based on our investigation, they seem to have fled.
say:1:1033702001:1.female: Based on our investigation, they seem to have fled.

say:2:1033702002:1.text: Most of the houses are wide open. After poking around a bit, we found belongings scattered all over the place.
say:2:1033702002:1.source_cn: 村里所有房门都没有上锁，我们随机探查了其中的几间，发现...
say:2:1033702002:1.male: Most of the houses are wide open. After poking around a bit, we found belongings scattered all over the place.
say:2:1033702002:1.female: Most of the houses are wide open. After poking around a bit, we found belongings scattered all over the place.

say:3:1033702003:1.text: But we never got wind of any issues in Rainford before! How did this happen?
say:3:1033702003:1.source_cn: 可我们之前并没有收到关于沐霖村的任何消息！为什么？
say:3:1033702003:1.male: But we never got wind of any issues in Rainford before! How did this happen?
say:3:1033702003:1.female: But we never got wind of any issues in Rainford before! How did this happen?
